title: Stock Valuation: Average per Item

purpose.en: Stock is valued at a moving Average. With INV_AVG_SCOPE = ITEM there is one Average per item for the whole company; with BIN each bin keeps its own Average (the old way).
purpose.id: Stok dinilai dengan rata-rata bergerak (Average). Dengan INV_AVG_SCOPE = ITEM ada satu Average per item untuk seluruh perusahaan; dengan BIN tiap bin punya Average sendiri (cara lama).

keywords: average, rata-rata, harga rata-rata, valuasi, nilai stok, per item, per bin, inv_avg_scope, revalue, peralihan, cutover, nilai persediaan

steps.en: A receipt raises the Average: (item value + received value) / (item quantity + received quantity). An issue or minus adjustment is valued at the Average of that moment and does not change it.
steps.id: Penerimaan menaikkan Average: (nilai item + nilai terima) / (qty item + qty terima). Pengeluaran atau adjustment minus bernilai Average saat itu dan tidak mengubahnya.

steps.en: A transfer between bins moves quantity and value at the item Average. The item total and the Average stay the same and no journal is made.
steps.id: Transfer antar bin memindah qty dan nilai pada Average item. Total item dan Average tetap sama dan tidak ada jurnal.

steps.en: Stock owned by a customer or supplier is not valued and does not enter the Average. The Stock Card still shows BB and EB per row, continuous.
steps.id: Stok milik customer atau supplier tidak dinilai dan tidak ikut Average. Stock Card tetap menampilkan BB dan EB tiap baris, bersambung.

steps.en: A document dated earlier than later rows is inserted in its place and the later rows are recalculated; the changed value of later issues is reported.
steps.id: Dokumen bertanggal lebih awal disisipkan di tempatnya dan baris sesudahnya dihitung ulang; perubahan nilai pengeluaran berikutnya dilaporkan.

steps.en: Before switching: run inv:revalue-per-item --check (writes nothing, total value must not change), then --apply (writes one cutover point per item, no journal).
steps.id: Sebelum beralih: jalankan inv:revalue-per-item --check (tidak menulis, total nilai tidak boleh berubah), lalu --apply (menulis satu titik peralihan per item, tanpa jurnal).

steps.en: Then set INV_AVG_SCOPE to ITEM in Setup > Constants (Text Value BIN or ITEM). Setting it back to BIN restores the per-bin way for new postings.
steps.id: Lalu ubah INV_AVG_SCOPE menjadi ITEM di Setup > Constants (Text Value BIN atau ITEM). Mengembalikannya ke BIN memulihkan cara per bin untuk posting baru.

steps.en: Check the proof in Inventory > Reports > Valuation Check: per item, the value of all bins must equal the item value from the Average item. Difference must be 0.
steps.id: Cek buktinya di Inventory > Reports > Valuation Check: per item, nilai semua bin harus sama dengan nilai item dari Average item. Selisih harus 0.

steps.en: Screens that show a price (warehouse map, transfer approval value, adjustment price) read the Average item when the scope is ITEM; the bin value stays the value of that bin.
steps.id: Layar yang menampilkan harga (peta gudang, nilai approval transfer, harga adjustment) membaca Average item bila scope ITEM; nilai bin tetap nilai bin itu.

fields.label: INV_AVG_SCOPE
fields.en: Text Value in Setup > Constants: BIN (one Average per item per bin) or ITEM (one Average per item for all bins).
fields.id: Text Value di Setup > Constants: BIN (satu Average per item per bin) atau ITEM (satu Average per item untuk semua bin).

title: Valuation Check

purpose.en: Proves that valuing stock per item changes no total: for every item it shows the quantity, the Average, and the value of all bins. The Difference must be zero. Use it before and after switching INV_AVG_SCOPE.
purpose.id: Membuktikan bahwa penilaian stok per item tidak mengubah total: tiap item menampilkan qty, Average, dan nilai semua bin. Selisihnya harus nol. Pakai sebelum dan sesudah INV_AVG_SCOPE diganti.

keywords: valuation check, cek valuasi, average per item, selisih nilai, total nilai, inv_avg_scope, peralihan, cutover, rekonsiliasi nilai stok

steps.en: Open the report and click Show. Each row is one item with its quantity, Average and total bin value.
steps.id: Buka laporan lalu klik Show. Tiap baris satu item dengan qty, Average, dan total nilai bin.

steps.en: Check the Difference column. A row that is not zero is shown in red and must be fixed before switching to per-item valuation.
steps.id: Periksa kolom Difference. Baris yang tidak nol tampil merah dan harus diperbaiki sebelum beralih ke penilaian per item.

steps.en: Run the report before the switch, then again after it. The company total value must be the same in both.
steps.id: Jalankan laporan sebelum beralih, lalu lagi sesudahnya. Total nilai perusahaan harus sama di keduanya.
